title: PIL in Punjab and Haryana High Court to restore Diljit Dosanjh-starrer Satluj on Zee5
description: A Public Interest Litigation (PIL) petition has been filed before the Punjab and Haryana High Court seeking the restoration of the Punjabi singer-actor Diljit Dosanjh-starrer film Satluj on the Zee5 OTT platform.The film, based on the life and death of human rights activist Jaswant Singh, Khalra was taken down from the OTT platform just two days after its release.
